name: confirm-action
title: Confirm action
description: Make room for a deliberate second click.
docs: Import { ConfirmAction } from your configured components alias under bera/confirm-action. Keep its companion CSS. Supply the real onConfirm operation. Opening only arms the control and focuses Cancel; Enter or Space cannot confirm through a held key. Cancel and Escape return to the original action before commitment. Pending operations cannot overlap or be canceled by closing the control. Rejection keeps confirmation available with an error; success persists until the host remounts for a restored or different resource. Keep resource state and restoration in the host. Without onConfirm the production control is disabled. The preview archives and restores local data only. Replay changes presentation without changing state, invoking callbacks, or moving focus. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/confirm-action.agent.md
